about_short_description.short_description: Criteo is a global technology company that serves personalized online display advertisements to consumers on behalf of e-commerce companies.

product.name: Commerce Media Platform
product.description: A commerce advertising platform connecting brands, retailers, agencies, and media owners to activate commerce data, run campaigns, and monetize digital inventory across the open internet.

product.name: Performance Media
product.description: AI-powered digital advertising services for acquiring and retaining customers through personalized campaigns across the open internet and multiple digital channels.

product.name: Retail Media Platform
product.description: An end-to-end platform for buying and selling retail media, helping brands reach shoppers near purchase and enabling retailers to monetize first-party data and digital properties.

product.name: Criteo GO
product.description: A self-service performance advertising solution that enables brands of different sizes to launch and manage AI-powered campaigns with simplified cross-channel execution.

product.name: Commerce Growth
product.description: An advertising platform for marketers and agencies focused on automated customer acquisition and retention using commerce data and AI-based campaign decisioning.

product.name: Commerce Max
product.description: A retail media solution for brands and agencies that extends retail media buying beyond retailer properties into open-internet environments.
